title: 7TH EDITION OF MARSHAL OF THE AIR FORCE ARJAN SINGH MEMORIAL HOCKEY TOURNAMENT-2026
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Defence

7TH EDITION OF MARSHAL OF THE AIR FORCE ARJAN SINGH MEMORIAL HOCKEY TOURNAMENT-2026

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
03 JUL 2026 4:33PM by PIB Delhi

7th edition of Marshal of the Air Force Arjan Singh Memorial Hockey Tournament was conducted from 23 Jun to 03 Jul 26 at Amit Singh Bakshi Hockey Stadium, Air Force Station Jalahalli. A total of 16 teams participated in this tournament.

The Closing Ceremony was conducted on 03 Jul 26 at 0730 Hr. Air Marshal Seethepalli Shrinivas, Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief, Training Command graced the ceremony as the Chief Guest. Ms. Baljeet Kaur, Indian field Hockey player and Mr. Sreejesh PR, Olympian, Indian field Hockey player were the Guest of Honour (GoH) for the closing ceremony.

The final match of the tournament was played between Indian Air Force and Indian Navy. Indian Air Force Hockey team won the final match by 2-1 goals. Sgt Anand Lakra (Air Force) and AGV (S) Agyapal (Air Force) were declared as Man of the match and player of the tournament respectively.

 The medals and trophies were presented to winner and runner up teams along with cash award for Rs 10,00,000/- and 8,00,000/- respectively.

***
